hero.lead: A nation of 14.4 million on the shore of the second-largest freshwater lake on Earth by volume, where one citizen in five has electricity.

capital.heading: 15 instruments. Hydropower, clean water, human capital and a new private power utility.

register.name: Water Supply and Sanitation Access Project (PAEPA)
register.detail: Announced 10 December 2025 · IDA grant · Government adds $10 million
register.text: A new treatment plant adds 60,000 m³ of water a day to Bujumbura. Clean water for 615,000 people, about 490,000 of them piped at home, and basic sanitation for 55,000 people in rural areas: the Bank’s first water and sanitation operation in Burundi in more than 15 years.

register.name: Colline Climate Resilience Project
register.text: Strengthens the resilience of hillside communities and landscapes.

register.name: MIGA guarantee for Weza Power
register.detail: Issued 19 December 2024 · Breach of contract cover · Up to three years
register.note: Covers the feasibility phase for now
register.text: Covers Anzana Electric Group’s investment in Weza Power against breach of the project agreement. Weza Power is a new private utility in a public-private partnership to extend electricity distribution and rural electrification, the energy standard.

register.name: Human Capital Development Project
register.text: Invests in the health and learning of children and families.

register.name: Urban Resilience Emergency Project
register.text: Protects towns against floods and lake-level rise.

register.name: Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation (ASCENT Burundi)
register.text: Part of the regional programme to connect households and services to clean power.

register.name: Access to Finance to Import Strategic Commodities (AFISC)
register.detail: Announced 10 January 2024 · IDA grant · Two-year trade facility at the central bank
register.text: Backs commercial banks’ letters of credit for imports of fertilizer and pharmaceuticals while the currency is liberalised, through the Banque de la République du Burundi. About 2 million smallholder farmers are expected to benefit from the fertilizer.

register.name: Jobs and Economic Transformation Project
register.text: Supports firms and value chains that create jobs.

register.name: Transport Resilience Project
register.note: Roads that hold in the rains
register.text: Improves the resilience of key transport links.

register.name: Cash for Jobs Project
register.text: Cash transfers and productive inclusion for poor households.

register.name: Jiji and Mulembwe Hydropower
register.detail: Approved 22 April 2014 · Jiji inaugurated June 2025 · Mulembwe inaugurated June 2026
register.text: Built two hydropower plants in the south of the country, 32.5 MW at Jiji and 17 MW at Mulembwe, which the African Development Bank says will nearly double national generation capacity. Clean power for a grid that reaches one citizen in five.

register.name: Water Sector and Climate Resilience Building Support Programme (PASEREC), Phase 1
register.detail: Additional grant announced 24 October 2025 · African Development Fund, Climate Action Window · To 2029
register.text: Safe drinking water for about 500,000 people in Bubanza, Cibitoke, Cankuzo, Rutana and Ruyigi, with 17 solar-powered water systems, eco-friendly sanitation and irrigation. About 2,700 jobs, 80% of them for young people and women.

register.name: SEFA project preparation grant to Weza Power
register.detail: Announced 5 June 2025 · Sustainable Energy Fund for Africa
register.text: Speeds the preparation of Weza Power, the public-private utility planned to extend electricity across Burundi, including its environmental and social work before full operations begin.

register.name: Technical assistance grant to Weza Power
register.text: Funds a pilot to connect more than 40,000 new households and businesses from 2025, and the preparation of a national network expansion under the public-private partnership.

register.name: Songa Energy hydropower: Upper Ruvyironza and Upper Mulembwe
register.detail: Announced 11 February 2025 · Long-term project finance debt · ATIDI political risk cover
register.note: 10.65 MW in two small hydropower plants
register.text: Project finance for two run-of-the-river plants in south-central Burundi, 1.65 MW and 9.0 MW, expected on the grid in 2025 and 2027. Private power for a grid that reaches one citizen in five.

items.name: One Acre Fund (Tubura)
items.text: Working in Burundi as Tubura since 2011: seed and fertilizer on credit, training from field officers and tree seedlings for smallholders; it reports 383,000 farmers served.
